item.title: 7 Original Dragon Ball Episodes That Are Completely Unhinged Today
item.description: If Dragon Ball Z is the anime equivalent of a blistering, high-octane heavy metal guitar solo, all screaming, lightning, and earth-shattering power, then the very beginning of the original 1986 Dragon Ball series is a guy furiously playing a kazoo while falling down a flight of stairs.
